definitions.gloss: predecessor; former holder of a position
definitions.explanation: The person who held a position, role, or office before the current one. Used in workplace and organizational contexts.

examples.japanese: {前任者|ぜんにんしゃ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{継|つ}ぐ→引き継ぐ：12458_hikitsugu⟧。
examples.english: To take over from one's predecessor.

examples.japanese: {前任者|ぜんにんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: It's very different from the way the predecessor did things.

examples.japanese: {前任者|ぜんにんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the documents left by my predecessor before starting work.

notes:
{前任者|ぜんにんしゃ} refers to the person who previously held a particular position or role. Composed of ⟦{前任|ぜんにん}→前任：20113_zennin⟧ (previous appointment) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前任者|ぜんにんしゃ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{継|つ}ぐ→引き継ぐ：12458_hikitsugu⟧: to take over from a predecessor
- {前任者|ぜんにんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧: the predecessor's policy
- {前任者|ぜんにんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}ぐ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧: to succeed one's predecessor
- {前任者|ぜんにんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧: compared to the predecessor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後任者|こうにんしゃ}: successor (person who takes over)
- ⟦{後任|こうにん}→後任：12580_kounin⟧: successor/replacement (without ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{前任|ぜんにん}→前任：20113_zennin⟧: previous appointment/tenure (without ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧)
- ⟦{後継者|こうけいしゃ}→後継者：12592_koukeisha⟧: successor, heir (broader — not just job positions)
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{継|つ}ぎ→引き継ぎ：08365_hikitsugi⟧: handover, transition of duties
